_source: H:\AR-JP\JP\215\MAENOTE.215 + MAEIMG.215, pages JD01-JD10 (drawings AJDMD10R35 .. AJDMDA0R35), rendered with fast_image.js 2026-09-04 and transcribed by eye. Positions are the plate's 14th-18th characters, i.e. mc.slice(12,17) of the stored model code (position 1 is dropped by the export).
_verified: Against all 8,046 records in fast_r35.json: 40,167 of 40,230 option characters resolve in the window that owns the record's build month (99.84%); 56 resolve only in an adjacent window (all within 9 months of a boundary except one, all pre-release adoptions: SPEC-V cars from 2008-03 already carrying ETCTR, EGOIST cars from 2010-06 already carrying EGOIST interior codes); 7 are undefined in every window (position 16 'B', 2010-06/07, grades R and Y).
_boundary_rule: A boundary month belongs to the newer window. A letter the owning window does not define is looked up in the nearest other window by months and marked as such, never treated as confirmed.
